name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=settings_menu, descriptor=input_step) and accurately reflects the function: one keystroke poll/step for the cross-shape 4-direction settings-style dialog. No address residue. Matches the sibling cluster fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_close_settings_dialog_with_slide that the same 5 callers use. Although used by 5 menus (not only the options menu), all 5 share the settings-style cross dialog, so the name remains apt.
purpose: Process one keystroke for a 4-direction (cross-shape) settings/options menu: commit, cancel, or move the cursor to an enabled direction slot.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint(menu_options, menu_state) to block until a key arrives while the dialog keeps repainting. Maps the returned scancode: 0x01 Esc -> return -1 (cancel); 0x39 Space / 0x1C Enter -> return 1 (commit); 0x48 Up / 0x4B Left / 0x4D Right / 0x50 Down -> if the corresponding menu_state slot ([0]/[1]/[2]/[3]) is 0 (enabled), store the slot index (0/1/2/3) into data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx and return 0; any other scancode or a disabled slot -> return 0 (no-op). Disassembly @ 0x177FC confirms: param2 (EBX) is the indexed array, Up->[EBX], Left->[EBX+4], Right->[EBX+8], Down->[EBX+0xc]; cursor global write is dword[0x53C57]; param1 is forwarded as the first arg to fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint and never indexed here.

params.name: menu_state
params.semantics: param1 (Stack[0x4]); the options/label array (the *3 array). Forwarded unmodified as the first argument to fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint, which passes it on to fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders where it is used as menu_options[c]*3. Never indexed in this function. The live Ghidra name 'menu_state' is a misnomer (it is the options array, not the state array); the home-file declaration already uses the correct name 'menu_options'.
params.reason: Live Ghidra param name 'menu_state' is a misnomer: this argument is the options/label array (*3), forwarded to fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint and never used as slot state here. Renaming to 'menu_options' matches the home-file declaration and the file-wide sibling convention (open/close/repaint all name the *3 array menu_options and the *2 array menu_state). Rename to be applied in Stage 2.

params.name: pSlot_disable_arr
params.semantics: param2 (Stack[0x8]); int[4] slot-state/disable array indexed by direction (Up=[0]/slot0, Left=[1]/slot1, Right=[2]/slot2, Down=[3]/slot3). 0 = slot enabled (cursor may land), non-zero = disabled. Checked before moving the cursor for each arrow key.
params.reason: Semantically accurate name but inconsistent with the file-wide convention. The home-file declaration and sibling functions (fd2_open/close_settings_dialog_with_slide, fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders) all call this *2 / slot-state array 'menu_state'. Renaming pSlot_disable_arr -> menu_state aligns Ghidra with the source and siblings. Rename to be applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: 1 = committed (Space/Enter); -1 = cancelled (Esc); 0 = continue (cursor moved to an enabled slot, or no-op / disabled slot / unmapped key). Callers loop while the return is 0.

reads_globals: data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (only when storing on a cursor move; read indirectly via the same global as a write target)
writes_globals: data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (0x53C57) -- set to 0/3/1/2 for Up/Down/Left/Right when the target direction slot is enabled
